Seal MCP proxy upstream identity

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-62
  description: |-
    Fail Codex runtime profiles closed when third-party MCP capabilities cannot use a Codeon-owned execution boundary.
    
    Bind Cursor and Grok capability proxies to the sealed server identity, endpoint or executable digest, and full observed tool catalog. Revalidate executable identity around spawn and reject upstream identity or catalog drift before serving authorized calls.
